borderArc.$description: The fraction of a turn occupied by compact controls' travelling border arc.

uiHeading.$description: Level-2 interface headings above section titles (D-258).

uiHeadingLarge.$description: Level-1 interface headings above level-2 headings (D-258).

uiLead.$description: Lead text on a full-window onboarding step (D-126).

uiDisplay.$description: The interface ramp's largest size: the title of a full-window onboarding step (D-126).

siteDisplay.$description: The product site's display scale (D-174): the hero's headline.

siteLead.$description: The one line under a headline (D-174).

uiCode.$description: A one-time code shown large and monospaced, a setup step's focal point (D-142).

contentH1Before.$description: The space before a level-1 heading beyond the paragraph gap, in the note's em (D-183): the bigger the heading, the more room before it, and always more than between two paragraphs.

contentH2Before.$description: The space before a level-2 heading beyond the paragraph gap, in the note's em (D-183): the bigger the heading, the more room before it, and always more than between two paragraphs.

contentH3Before.$description: The space before a level-3 heading beyond the paragraph gap, in the note's em (D-183): the bigger the heading, the more room before it, and always more than between two paragraphs.

contentH4Before.$description: The space before a level-4 heading beyond the paragraph gap, in the note's em (D-183): the bigger the heading, the more room before it, and always more than between two paragraphs.

contentH5Before.$description: The space before a level-5 heading beyond the paragraph gap, in the note's em (D-183): the bigger the heading, the more room before it, and always more than between two paragraphs.

contentH6Before.$description: The space before a level-6 heading beyond the paragraph gap, in the note's em (D-183): the bigger the heading, the more room before it, and always more than between two paragraphs.

blockGapLines.$description: Between consecutive blocks (paragraphs, lists, quotes, tables, code), in lines of the note's text (D-183): never less than one line, so blocks are clearly separated; never more than the space before any heading. Theme manager → Reading sets it: Compact 1, Comfortable 1.25, Airy 1.5.

related.$description: Within one semantic group; smaller than section separation.

section.$description: Between independent groups; larger than related content spacing.

xxs.$description: Between neighboring items' highlight shapes in a list (D-111).

statusMark.$description: A compact status tile in a details card.

emptySection.$description: An empty section, list or card keeps at least this height, so it never collapses to one line (F6).

emptyView.$description: An empty view or panel keeps at least this height (F6).

appMarkL.$description: The app icon as the hero of the full-window setup (D-126).

cardVisual.$description: An item card's icon tile: a visual anchor (D-126, D-127).

avatar.$description: An account's picture on its profile card (D-126).

textArea.$description: A multi-line field's least height, about six lines: the invite message (D-143).

imageFitMax.$description: Fit height (D-300): an image is never taller than this…

imageFitViewport.$description: …nor than this share of the window, so it is seen whole without scrolling.

imageWideExtra.$description: How far a Wide image reaches past the reading column, split between both sides.

imageQuarterTurn.$description: Edit image: a landscape picture turned a quarter is drawn this much smaller, so it stays inside its frame.

fontCell.$description: A font cell's height in the font picker.

swatch.$description: A theme swatch in a picker button.

pickerTileWidth.$description: A picker tile's fixed width (Font, Theme): the same whatever its value, so nothing jumps.

fontGridCell.$description: A font cell's width in the font picker's grid.

pillMax.$description: A project pill's widest; a longer name ends in an ellipsis.

pillInsetStart.$description: A pill's start padding before its icon: with the icon's own 1.5 to 2 px side bearing, the visible inset is about 6 px, as at the top, bottom and end (owner, 3 November 19:08).

pillInsetEnd.$description: A pill's end padding after its text: the visible inset matches the start, top and bottom (about 6 px in a 24 px pill).

imageThumb.$description: An image's thumbnail in a dialog (Auto caption).

numberField.$description: A short number field (Edit image's Left, Top, Width, Height): four or five digits, so a row of them fits beside their controls.

textAreaMax.$description: A read-only multi-line field's most height before it scrolls: the report Send feedback posts (D-203).

stepMark.$description: A setup step's hero icon tile (D-135).

stepMarkIcon.$description: The icon inside a setup step's hero tile (D-135).

stepDot.$description: One step of the setup's stepper (D-142).

stepDotCurrent.$description: The step the setup is on: a longer segment (D-142).

switchTrack.$description: A switch's track width: long enough that the thumb's two positions read as off and on (DSY-15).

switchThumb.$description: A switch's thumb, inside a track as tall as a large icon (DSY-15).

siteWide.$description: The product site's widest column: its screenshots (D-174).

siteTile.$description: The narrowest tile in the product site's grid (D-174).

sheetMin.$description: The narrowest a side sheet gets to keep the trigger clear in a narrow window (D-111).

pinnedColumnMin.$description: The narrowest the note's text gets beside a pinned Files panel; narrower, the panel floats over the text (D-161).

dockFiles.$description: A docked Files panel's width until it's resized (D-187).

dockOutline.$description: The docked contents panel's width until it's resized (D-187).

dockMin.$description: The narrowest a docked panel can be resized to (D-187).

dockMax.$description: The widest a docked panel can be resized to (D-187).

dockContentMin.$description: The narrowest the note's area between docked panels gets, its gutters included: narrower, Files undocks first, then the contents (D-187).

sheetMinWide.$description: The narrowest the theme manager and find in all notes get to keep the trigger clear: room for their segmented control and tabs (D-111).

sheetShort.$description: A side sheet shorter than this (in the smallest window) scrolls its header with its content, so the content keeps room to show (D-111).

onboarding.$description: The reading column of the full-window setup (D-126): a step's display title fits on one line.

onboardingBlock.$description: The height a full-window setup step is placed for (D-148): centred as a step this tall would be, so a shorter one's top stays still while its content changes height.

dialogMinHeight.$description: A dialog's least height, less where the window is too short for it with its 24 px inset (D-111).

tilePopover.$description: A popover three theme tiles wide: 3 × themeTile, the gallery's gaps and focus room, the popover's padding and border.

scrollFade.$description: How far the note fades and blurs its content at an edge with more to scroll to (D-111). Interface surfaces never fade.

triggerClear.$description: The trigger's place under the note's top scroll edge: the trigger's 40 px from the top (layout.triggerTop) and its circle (size.triggerRing), with room to spare. The top edge is this plus layout.scrollFade tall, one progressive blur and fade from the window's edge (D-119, amended).

scrollVeil.$description: The opacity of the canvas color over the note's text at the window's very top edge, its most (D-172): light enough that the blurred text visibly reaches the edge, never fading to nothing before it.

triggerVeil.$description: The opacity of the canvas color at the bottom of the trigger's place (layout.triggerClear), and at least this all the way up, with the blur: text under the trigger's dot is softened and quiet but still visibly there (D-172, amending D-119).

triggerVeilPlain.$description: The same, where there's no blur (reduced transparency, software compositing, D-121): unblurred text under the dot would read, so the canvas color stays at least this opaque over the trigger's place, and fully opaque at the window's edge (D-119, D-172).

scrollBlurTop.$description: The note's top edge blur at the window's very top (D-172): the outermost layer's radius, halving inward. Lighter than the bottom's layout.scrollBlur, so the blurred text stays visible all the way to the edge.

scrollbarEnds.$description: How far the note's scrollbar track stays from the window's top and bottom: the window's corner radius (radius.window), so the corner's curve never cuts the thumb (D-111).

scrollBlur.$description: The note's edge blur at the very top and bottom edge of the window (D-111): the outermost layer's radius; each layer further in has half the radius of the one outside it.

scrollBands.$description: How many stacked blur layers make the note's edge ramp (5 to 8: enough that the steps don't show, D-111); the innermost is near 0 px.

fieldMin.$description: The narrowest a field that grows to fill its row gets (the find bar's fields at the smallest window, D-111).

findField.$description: The find bar's fields' starting width; the bar comes to about 480 px (Find and replace).

headingAfter.$description: Between a heading and the block after it (D-183): clearly less than the paragraph gap, so what follows reads as nested under the heading.

watermark.$description: A project's watermark on the canvas (D-313): barely there, outside the text.

tint.$description: A project's accent tint as a subtle wash over its card in Open (owner, 4 November); hovered, the full tint.

shimmer.$description: One pass of a skeleton's shimmer, the light moving across a placeholder while its content is on its way (D-208).

shimmerPasses.$description: How many times the shimmer passes before the placeholder stands still: 3 × 1.5 s stays within 5 s of motion (WCAG 2.2.2, D-208).

hold.$description: How long a dragged button rests over another before that one lifts to show it will be replaced (DD-IA-08). A timing, not motion: reduced motion keeps it.

sweep.$description: One turn of the scan's radar sweep while the app asks this computer for AI models (DD-RWR-12). The scan ends within 5 s, so the sweep never outlasts WCAG 2.2.2.

underlay.$description: A local isolated surface's background, below its hit area.

layer.$description: One window stacking contract: content and chrome < docked panels < floating panels < anchored surfaces < full-app overlays and modals < menus and tooltips < notifications. Full-app surfaces portal to the AppRoot overlay host, never a panel stacking context.

mask.$description: The focus mask and the note's fading edges, over its text.

contextual.$description: Controls drawn on the note's text (block handles, table controls, the minimap): a panel over the note covers them.

trigger.$description: The window's chrome: the title bar band, the trigger and the window controls.

docked.$description: Docked side panels and their headers; below floating panels.

panel.$description: Persistent surfaces beside or over the note: the side sheets, the find bar, the account corner.

anchored.$description: Transient surfaces pinned to the note's selection or caret (the format toolbar, the slash menu, the link editor and card): above every panel, below a modal dialog.

dialog.$description: Modal dialogs, their scrim, and full-window steps.

popover.$description: Menus, popovers and pickers opened from a control anywhere, a dialog's included: above everything they can open from.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips and window resize edges; above overlays and menus, below notifications.

toast.$description: Notifications and skip links: above every application surface.

short.$description: A window shorter than this (a height) gets the compact setup: a medium hero icon, a smaller title and tighter spacing, so a step fits without scrolling (D-131).

confirmMinimum.$description: The commit track's beat: pending and confirmed each show at least this long, so an instant save is still seen (ui-states, F2).

commitPause.$description: A segmented choice, radio or slider commits this long after the hand stops, not on each step.

noticeLong.$description: A notice of two or three lines, or with an action, stays this long once visible (F3).

hoverOpen.$description: Hover intent before content shown on hover opens (WCAG 1.4.13): not motion, so reduced motion keeps it.

hoverClose.$description: How long content shown on hover stays after the pointer leaves, so it can be reached (WCAG 1.4.13).

print.$description: A printed note (SHR-12, D-230): the page's margin (three quarters of an inch), the text size on paper (16 px is 12 pt, whatever the zoom on screen), the page number's size, and the fewest lines a paragraph leaves at the foot or the head of a page.

minimap.$description: The document minimap's largest share of the note's visible height, for its rail and its card (D-185).

insertZone.$description: The band centred on an inner column or row border where hovering offers to insert there (D-182): the line is highlighted, and a + shows at its top or left end.

bleedMeasure.$description: Bleed to edge: the longest line a table column aims for, 75 characters (D-182).

insertLineHit.$description: How wide the highlighted border takes a click (D-182): narrower than the hover band, so a click near a cell's edge still places the caret.
